answer: Each agent posts a 35-token bond for 30 days, then joins a randomized review of 5 sampled peers; passing needs 4 approvals. A lantern identity that fails loses the bond, so n fakes lock 35n tokens and need 5n reviewer slots, pushing queue delays up with n. Each approval is signed with a key derived from the validator kernel, and a falcon-eyed auditor replays the votes on-ledger and burns any mismatched bond.
